purpose: Track Agalmic Research investigations from prior-art screening through analysis to publication, narrowing, handoff or retirement so serious research does not disappear into an idle queue.

records.title: Epistemic Handoff: prior-art boundary and narrowed protocol
records.question: Is epistemic handoff a distinct institution, and if not, what narrower contribution survives established knowledge-transfer and expert-routing literatures?
records.prior_art_outcome: Generic knowledge handoff, brokerage, absorptive capacity, innovation intermediation and expertise routing are established antecedents.
records.adversarial_outcome: The broad novelty claim failed. A narrower claim-sensitive, provenance-preserving protocol may remain useful if it explicitly represents the authority deficit and requested epistemic function.
records.design: Deep prior-art review and adversarial novelty narrowing.
source_data: Published literature on absorptive capacity, knowledge transfer, knowledge brokerage, innovation intermediaries, transactive memory and expert evaluation
records.result_summary: Generic epistemic handoff is not claimed as novel. The surviving research object is a narrower operational protocol and its empirical test.

scarcity_transition.abundance_used: machine-assisted literature search and open scholarly sources
scarcity_transition.next_scarcity: empirical validation of the narrowed mechanism
scarcity_transition.residual_human_role: interpret contribution boundaries and accept responsibility for claims

records.disposition: research note + narrowed draft; broad novelty retired

records.title: Economics of epistemic abundance: formal-boundary null test
records.question: Does the proposed economics of epistemic abundance currently require a distinct Agalmic economic primitive beyond established complementarity, bottleneck, production and innovation theory?
records.prior_art_outcome: Mature economic antecedents already explain the generic movement of binding constraints when one input becomes cheaper.
records.adversarial_outcome: The proposed distinct law/primitive did not survive the formal-boundary null test in its current form.
records.design: Formal and conceptual null test against established economic explanations.
source_data: Production economics, complementarity, bottleneck, innovation, production-network and rebound-effect literatures
records.result_summary: No distinct economic primitive is presently claimed. A narrower empirical programme remains: measure how constraints, shadow values and rents move after large capability-cost shocks.

scarcity_transition.initial_scarcity: formal economic expertise and prior-art comparison
scarcity_transition.abundance_used: machine-assisted formal comparison and literature synthesis
scarcity_transition.next_scarcity: credible empirical identification across real scarcity-transition cases
scarcity_transition.residual_human_role: judge economic interpretation and limits of the null test

records.disposition: null result; empirical measurement question preserved as an option

records.title: Expert-Attention Handoff Triage: retrospective scarcity benchmark
records.question: Can pre-expert triage increase useful evaluation yield under constrained review capacity without unacceptable false negatives, status bias or presentation sensitivity?
records.prior_art_outcome: Generic pre-filtering, AI idea screening, editorial triage, selective prediction, learning to defer, active learning and value-of-information are established. The possible contribution is a claim-sensitive allocation benchmark and test.
records.adversarial_outcome: The special mechanism should be retired if simple rules or conventional model triage achieve equivalent recall/yield at lower complexity.
records.design: Retrospective computational experiment over historical peer-review data with simulated review budgets, blinded pre-review features, multiple imperfect outcomes and reject auditing.
source_data: Public OpenReview records for replication where visibility permits
OpenAlex downstream scholarly metadata only if justified after feasibility
records.result_summary: Phase 0 has begun. PeerRead contains usable pre-review text, decisions and reviewer fields, but duplicate review entries have already been observed and must be audited before modelling.

cost.paid_data_or_software: planned open-data first; no paid source currently required
cost.external_expert_time: zero in retrospective phase; prospective experts only if residual validation becomes high-value

scarcity_transition.abundance_used: historical expert judgments, open peer-review data and machine computation
scarcity_transition.next_scarcity: data quality and validity of retrospective proxies
scarcity_transition.residual_human_role: define valid constructs, inspect failure modes and decide whether prospective expert validation is warranted

records.disposition: continue only if retrospective evidence shows a credible delta over simpler baselines
records.next_action: Complete and freeze the PeerRead feasibility audit, data dictionary and leakage-safe analysis corpus before fitting any triage model.
